title: 第三章 四目道长第四章 祖师上身
content_zh:
;;
秦尧停了下来，狐狸精默默松了一口气。
可就在此时，他突然又动了，庞大的身躯快若奔马，带着一串残影，瞬间来到对方面前，一拳重重砸在其心口。
“噗！”
狐狸精被打成了弓形，瞳孔飞速扩张，张口喷出一口赤血：“你不讲……”
“砰！”
不给她把话说完的机会，秦尧一脚踢在她脸上，将其脑袋狠狠踹进墙壁内，碎在墙壁里，以绝诈尸可能！
“呕。”
抱着脑袋的秋生听到打斗声终于停了，抬头一看，顿时浑身恶寒。
要不怎么说他和文才怕这位师弟比怕师父更严重呢？
原因就在这里。
九叔动手，无论除鬼还是诛妖，都潇洒飘逸，很少有特别血腥的时候。
师弟动手，不管是除鬼还是诛妖，不是碎心就是碎颅，一拳过去，要么胸膛碎掉，要么脑子碎掉，这玩意看多了比见鬼还吓人！
现在想想，幸亏师父当初在山野古村中带回了对方，否则世间不是会多出一个碎心魔王，就是会多出一个碎颅魔王。
至于说他是好人，不会如此凶残……
瞎扯淡！
“愣啥呢，还不赶紧去找钱？”见他傻了吧唧的在地上蹲着，秦尧大喝道。
秋生如梦初醒，急忙开始奔波，不一会儿便将大大小小的箱子堆在大堂中。
而当他再一次下楼时，却发现秦尧不知从哪里搞来了一辆驴车，将自己搬下来的箱子全部装在了板车上。
“最后一箱，对了，那些客人身上的钱财我们取不取？”秋生麻利的将手中箱子放到驴车上，轻声问道。

“不要。”秦尧果断摇头：“关门，走人。”
秋生听话的关上大门，甚至主动牵起了驴子，与秦尧一起消失在夜色之中……
黎明将至。
义庄院中，灯火通明。
远道而来的四目道长提起水壶，为桌子对面的九叔倒满茶水，安慰道：“师兄，你不是说自己新收的那徒弟天生神体，刀枪不入，棍棒难伤吗，既是如此，何必担忧？”
“我不是担心他，是担心他杀人。”九叔幽幽一叹：“杀鬼杀妖杀僵尸，这都无碍，可一旦杀了人，不管是好人还是坏人，都会给他产生一种杀了也就杀了的感觉，很容易令他走上歧途。”
见他愁眉不展，四目悄悄转移了话题：“师兄，这么多年了，你就没想过找一个道侣吗？”
“都这把年纪了，哪还有什么心思去想这事儿？”九叔摇了摇头：“下半辈子，多救些人，多除些妖，看着三个徒弟成家立业，将来为我养老送终就可以了。”
“师兄是地师六重吧，再努力努力，未必不能达到天师境界，增寿千载。”四目道长说：“修行四大要素，财侣法地，师弟我别的没有，大黄鱼还是有一些的，要不赶明给你拿一箱过来，你也买点东西补补。”
九叔刚要说话，突然听到门外传来一声驴叫，紧接着便看到秦尧推门走了进来，身后跟着许久未见的秋生。

Qin Yao stopped, and the vixen breathed a sigh of relief silently.
But at this moment, he suddenly moved again. His huge body was as fast as a galloping horse. With a series of afterimages, he came to the opponent in an instant and punched him hard in the heart.
"Poof!"
The vixen was beaten into a bow shape, his pupils expanded rapidly, and he opened his mouth and spat out a mouthful of red blood: "If you don't tell me..."
"Bang!"
Without giving her a chance to finish her sentence, Qin Yao kicked her in the face and kicked her head into the wall, breaking it into pieces to eliminate the possibility of deceiving her!
"Ugh."
Qiu Sheng, who was holding his head, heard that the sound of fighting finally stopped. When he looked up, he felt a chill all over his body.
Otherwise, why are he and Wen Cai more afraid of this junior brother than their master?
Here's why.
Uncle Jiu's actions, whether it's to eliminate ghosts or slay monsters, are always elegant and elegant, and there are rarely any particularly bloody moments.
Junior brother takes action, whether it's to eliminate ghosts or slay demons, it will either break the heart or the skull. With one punch, either the chest will be broken or the brain will be broken. Seeing too much of this stuff is scarier than seeing ghosts!
Thinking about it now, it was fortunate that Master had brought him back to the ancient mountain village. Otherwise, there would either have been one more Heart-Breaking Demon King or one more Skull-Breaking Demon King.
As for saying that he is a good person, he would not be so cruel...
Nonsense!
"What are you waiting for? Why don't you hurry up and find the money?" Qin Yao shouted when he saw him squatting on the ground stupidly.
Qiu Sheng woke up like a dream and started running around in a hurry. After a while, boxes of all sizes were piled in the lobby.
When he went downstairs again, he found that Qin Yao had obtained a donkey cart from somewhere and loaded all the boxes he had moved onto the cart.
"The last box, by the way, can we take the money from those guests?" Qiu Sheng quickly put the box in his hand on the donkey cart and asked softly.
"No." Qin Yao shook his head decisively: "Close the door and leave."
Qiu Sheng obediently closed the door, and even took the initiative to take the donkey, and disappeared into the night with Qin Yao...
Dawn is approaching.
In the Yizhuang courtyard, the lights are brightly lit.
Taoist Priest Four Eyes, who had come from afar, picked up the kettle, filled up the tea for Uncle Jiu across the table, and comforted him: "Brother, didn't you say that your new disciple is born with a divine body, invulnerable to swords and guns, and hard to be hurt by sticks? If that's the case, why worry?"
"I'm not worried about him, I'm worried about him killing people." Uncle Jiu sighed faintly: "It doesn't matter if you kill ghosts, demons, and zombies, but once you kill someone, whether it's a good person or a bad person, it will give him a feeling that it's just a matter of killing, and it's easy for him to go astray."
Seeing his frown, he quietly changed the subject: "Senior brother, after all these years, haven't you thought about finding a Taoist companion?"
"At this age, how can you still think about this matter?" Uncle Jiu shook his head: "In the second half of my life, I will save more people, get rid of more demons, watch my three apprentices get married and start a family, and in the future, I will take care of myself until I die."
"Senior brother is the sixth level of Earth Master. No matter how hard you work, you may not be able to reach the realm of Heavenly Master and extend your life span for thousands of years." Taoist Master Four Eyes said: "The four major elements of practice are the land of wealth lovers. I don't have anything else, but I still have some large yellow croakers. Why don't I bring you a box tomorrow and buy something to supplement it."
Just as Uncle Jiu was about to speak, he suddenly heard a donkey braying outside the door, and then he saw Qin Yao pushing the door open and walking in, followed by Qiu Sheng, whom he hadn't seen for a long time.
